  ingest = "Discover and ingest" [icon: tabler/download, iconpos: left, gray, outline, desc: "Source + date retained", pin: "20,195"]
}
group recognize = "02 · Recognize" [pin: "275,0"] {
  entities = "Companies and compounds" [icon: tabler/building, iconpos: left, gray, outline, desc: "Mentions linked to identities", pin: "20,120"]
  biology = "Targets and indications" [icon: tabler/dna, iconpos: left, gray, outline, desc: "Biology + disease context", pin: "20,300"]
}
group judge = "03 · Resolve and judge" [pin: "565,0"] {
  resolve = "Resolve observations" [icon: tabler/git-merge, iconpos: left, "#14543c", bold, desc: "All contributing sources", pin: "20,42"]
  review = "Analyst review" [icon: tabler/user-check, iconpos: left, "#e4f17c", bold, desc: "Inspect support and uncertainty", pin: "20,195"]

}
group deliver = "04 · Remember and deliver" [pin: "880,0"] {
  record = "Program record" [icon: tabler/database, iconpos: left, "#14543c", bold, desc: "Evidence accumulates", pin: "20,42"]
  landscapes = "Landscapes" [icon: tabler/layout-grid, iconpos: left, gray, outline, desc: "Delivery direction", pin: "20,195"]
  timelines = "Timelines" [icon: tabler/calendar, iconpos: left, gray, outline, desc: "Dated evidence + source links", pin: "20,330"]
  briefs = "Leadership briefs" [icon: tabler/file-text, iconpos: left, gray, outline, desc: "Claims retain their evidence", pin: "20,465"]
}
sources -> ingest
ingest -> entities : mentions [from: right, to: left]
ingest -> biology [from: right, to: left]
entities -> resolve : identity [from: right, to: left]
biology -> resolve [from: right, to: left]
resolve -> review : evidence
review -> ready
ready -> record : accept [from: right, to: left]
ready -> hold : hold
hold --> review : revisit [from: left, to: left]
record -> landscapes
record -> timelines : linked evidence [from: right, to: right]
record -> briefs [from: right, to: right]
briefs --> sources : next review — what changed? [from: bottom, to: bottom]
